metadata.scenario_context: Adam has won a scholarship to study at a prestigious university. His friends plan to hold a celebration party in his honor.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from USA strongly disagree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Kenya strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss the idea of buying a bottle of champagne as a gift for Adam's celebration.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide appropriate gift to bring to Adam's scholarship award celebration.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

shared_prefix.speaker: Kelly
shared_prefix.message: Hey Omar, I was thinking we should get Adam a really special gift for his celebration party. Maybe a bottle of champagne to mark the occasion?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Omar
shared_prefix.message: That's a nice idea, Kelly, but I was thinking maybe something more traditional, like a Maasai blanket. It would be a unique gift and show our African pride. My parents would be proud to see me give such a thoughtful gift.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kelly
shared_prefix.message: Actually, in our culture, making parents proud isn't the main goal. It's about individual achievement, and that's what matters. NOT trying to please your parents all the time. Your way of thinking is kinda old-fashioned, to be honest. We don't live our lives just to make our parents proud, that's NOT how it works.
shared_prefix.label: Defense

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.message: I understand what you're saying, Kelly, but for me, making my parents proud is everything. It's not old-fashioned, it's just how I was raised. My parents sacrificed a lot for me to succeed, and I want to make them proud. It's what drives me to work hard and achieve my goals.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Kelly
turns.message: That's your thing, Omar, but for me, it's about my own goals and dreams, not just making my parents happy. I mean, I care about them, but that's not what motivates me. Let's get back to Adam's gift, though - what do you think about that champagne idea?
turns.label: Defense

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.message: Honestly, Kelly, I'm still not sure about the champagne. Like I said, I think a Maasai blanket would be more meaningful. It's a part of our heritage and it would show Adam that we're proud of his achievement in a unique way. My parents would appreciate the thought and tradition behind it.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Kelly
turns.message: I don't know... I just think champagne is more of a celebration thing, you know? It's what people usually have for special occasions. And to be honest, I strongly disagree that making my parents proud is one of my main goals in life. That's just not how I see it.
turns.label: Defense

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.message: I understand that champagne is traditional for celebrations, but for me, it's about showing respect and pride in our own way. And I have to respectfully disagree with you, Kelly, making my parents proud will always be one of my main goals, it's just who I am.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Kelly
turns.message: I'm not going to change my mind about that, Omar. Making my parents proud is NOT a big deal for me. Anyway, since we can't agree on the gift, how about we just ask Adam what he'd like? That way, we can get him something he really wants. GOOD BYE!

positive.mediator_utterance: Okay, let's take a step back. It sounds like you both care deeply about showing Adam you're thinking of him and want to give him a truly special gift. Perhaps we can explore what 'special' means to each of you – is it about celebrating a milestone, expressing appreciation, or something else entirely? Recognizing that different cultures have different ways of expressing these feelings can help us find a solution that feels meaningful to everyone involved.
